name: Sherrod Brown

issue_poll.name: Fox News Poll of 1,015 Ohio registered voters, May 28-June 1, 2026 (Q8: most important issue to your vote for Senate)
issue_poll.note: Latest Ohio poll with a full published issue ranking that could be reached. Ranks 1-7 follow it (inflation 43, healthcare 12, immigration 11, jobs 8, Iran conflict 7, abortion 4, crime 4); 'political divisions' (9) dropped as untestable. Later Ohio polls agree on the top: Fox Aug 6-10 (inflation 40%, then healthcare, immigration) and NYT/Siena Sept 22-Oct 1 (economy/jobs 23, inflation 9, immigration 7); Fox Oct 15-19 and Marist Oct 15-18 tables were unreachable. Ranks 8-10 filled from the national BGSU poll of 1,200 likely voters (Sept 2026, pick up to three), next untaken items in order: government corruption 30%, threats to democracy 24%, national debt 14%/taxes 12%.

issues.detail: Return tariff revenue to families as rebates instead of refunding businesses
Let people over 50 and police/firefighters buy into Medicare; reverse 2025 federal Medicaid cuts; $35 insulin cap for seniors
Close border to unauthorized crossings; deport immigrants who commit crimes; delay ending Haitian legal status
Trade policy that protects domestic manufacturing and union bargaining; union labor on data center construction
Support efforts to end the U.S. war in Iran; oppose a new Middle East war
Ban stock trading by members of Congress and their spouses
Oppose tax breaks for the wealthy and corporations; spend on schools and roads instead of Iran war

plan_caveats: Special election for the rest of Vance's term; Ohio special-election winners are normally seated once results are certified, so Brown may be sworn in before 2027-01-03 (not verified). Dates kept per instructions.
Issue poll is from June 2026; the closer Fox (Oct 15-19) and Marist (Oct 15-18) Ohio tables could not be fetched. Ranks 8-10 come from national polling (BGSU, Sept 2026).
Campaign site (sherrodbrown.com) homepage not fetchable; its health-care and safety issue pages carry no year or opponent name and describe past bills, so they were not used as 2026 promises.
Health care: Medicare buy-in from WYSO (Dec 2025, as declared candidate); Medicaid-cut reversal from Cleveland19 (Oct 28, 2026); $35 insulin from WFMJ Decision 2026 profile.
Iran rated Partial: he faulted Husted for voting against efforts to end the war immediately and pledged to 'end this war', but named no bill or mechanism himself.
Inflation rated Concrete on the tariff-rebate proposal (a new program); his other cost messaging (data center developers should bear power costs) is directional.
Abortion and democracy: no 2026 forward-looking statements found; available material (guides.vote, 2024 coverage) is past record only.
Immigration source is a Fox News article critical of Brown; only his own quoted interview statements were used.
Minimum wage $17 (undated X post per guides.vote) not used because its date could not be confirmed.
